title: Fix CSV rerun pending manifest contract
summary: Fixed rerun pending-publish writers so CSV/review rerun promotion emits and validates the current pending manifest contract before parked outputs are treated as drain candidates.
reason: A live CSV rerun parked output wrote a legacy-shaped pending-publish manifest without pipeline_version, publish_transaction_id, and current subtitle/sidecar array fields. Autonomy health correctly failed closed and blocked new queue work until the manifest was manually recovered.
behavior_before: CSV rerun and Python rerun promotion could create legacy pending-publish manifests that the current PendingPushManifest contract rejected, leaving autonomy health blocked on manual recovery.
behavior_after: CSV rerun writes current pending-publish proof fields, Python rerun promotion validates PendingPushManifest before moving review outputs, and focused tests pin the manifest shape and source-preservation behavior.
manual_validation: Live pending manifest repair validated with PendingPushManifest.from_mapping; autonomy health blocker_count=0 after rescan.
rollback_plan: Revert the rerun manifest writer changes, API product-version handoff, focused tests, and coverage docs. If reverted, manually inspect pending-publish rows before rerun drain because legacy manifests may again require recovery.
